caseTitle.en: Two airways in the emergency department

condition.zh: 急症 · 緊急氣道與誤吸風險
condition.en: Emergency · urgent airway and aspiration risk

desc.zh: 呼叫器響，你帶著推車去急診。每一條氣道都是飽胃、都可能不穩，而且沒有人幫你排好刀表。
desc.en: The pager goes and you take the trolley to the emergency department. Every airway is a full stomach, every patient may be unstable, and nobody has written you a list.

desc.zh: 推車是你推的，藥是你抽的，抽吸是你開的。插管的人看聲門，你看監視器和時鐘。
desc.en: You push the trolley, draw up the drugs and switch on the suction. The intubator watches the cords; you watch the monitor and the clock.

role.zh: 麻醉科夜班主治醫師（師傅）

about.zh: 保溫杯裡永遠是冷掉的茶。講話很慢，走路很快。口頭禪：「復甦在前，插管在後。」
about.en: His flask always holds cold tea. Speaks slowly, walks fast. Catchphrase: 'Resuscitate first, intubate second.'

about.zh: 半夜的氣道都會變成他的問題，然後變成你的。ISBAR 講得很乾淨，講完會站在你旁邊不走。
about.en: Every airway after midnight becomes his problem, then yours. Clean ISBAR, and he stays at your elbow afterwards.

about.zh: 急救區的抽吸永遠開著兩條。她說「準備好了」的時候，是真的準備好了。
about.en: Two suction lines always running in resus. When she says 'ready', it is ready.

about.zh: 六十七歲，退休碼頭工人，酒精性肝硬化。今晚吐了兩盆血，意識混亂，一直想坐起來。內視鏡室在等他，但他現在保護不了自己的氣道。
about.en: Sixty-seven, retired dock worker, alcohol-related cirrhosis. Two basins of blood tonight, confused, keeps trying to sit up. Endoscopy is waiting, but right now he cannot protect his own airway.

about.zh: 一直說「他上個月真的戒了」。手裡抓著爸爸的健保卡。
about.en: Keeps saying 'he really did stop drinking last month'. Clutching his father's health card.

role.zh: 病人：機車事故，顏面外傷

about.zh: 二十八歲外送員，沒戴好安全帽。下巴和鼻子變形，嘴裡都是血，戴著頸圈，有酒味，一直想拔掉氧氣面罩。電腦斷層需要他不動。
about.en: Twenty-eight, delivery rider, helmet not fastened. Jaw and nose deformed, mouth full of blood, in a collar, smells of alcohol, keeps pulling at the oxygen mask. The CT scanner needs him still.

about.zh: 到院前通報一句話講完：年齡、機轉、氣道、生命徵象、幾分鐘到。
about.en: One-sentence pre-arrival call: age, mechanism, airway, vitals, minutes out.

about.zh: 白天的師傅。晚上也會看訊息。
about.en: The daytime mentor. She reads messages at night too.

plain.zh: 給飽胃病人插管的方法：預充氧後，誘導藥和肌肉鬆弛劑接連給，不用面罩通氣，直接放管，縮短胃內容物跑進肺的空窗。
plain.en: Intubating a full-stomach patient: after pre-oxygenation the induction drug and muscle relaxant go in back to back and the tube goes straight in, shrinking the window in which stomach contents can reach the lungs.

plain.zh: 胃裡有東西、會吐的狀態。急診病人不管幾點吃的，一律當飽胃：疼痛、出血、酒精、創傷都讓胃不排空。
plain.en: A stomach with contents that can come up. Every emergency patient is treated as one regardless of the clock: pain, bleeding, alcohol and trauma all stop the stomach emptying.

plain.zh: 胃裡的東西或血跑進肺裡。輕則肺炎，重則呼吸衰竭。插管前的抽吸、頭高、快速誘導，都是為了它。
plain.en: Stomach contents or blood entering the lungs: pneumonia at best, respiratory failure at worst. Suction, head-up and a rapid sequence are all about preventing it.

plain.zh: 插管前先讓肺裡存滿氧氣，爭取時間。吐血的病人很難做好，頭高、抽吸、鼻導管一起上。
plain.en: Filling the lungs with oxygen before intubation to buy time. Hard to do well in a patient vomiting blood: head-up, suction and nasal oxygen all at once.

plain.zh: 肝硬化讓血繞道到食道，形成脹大的靜脈。一破就大量吐血，內視鏡可以止血，但病人要先能保護氣道。
plain.en: Cirrhosis diverts blood into the oesophagus, forming swollen veins. When one bursts the bleeding is massive; endoscopy can stop it, but the patient must first be able to protect the airway.

plain.zh: 誘導前全隊停下來念一遍：病人、計畫 A 到 D、藥、抽吸、監視器、誰做什麼。手術室叫時間暫停，急診叫檢核表，一樣的東西。
plain.en: Before induction the whole team reads it aloud: patient, plans A to D, drugs, suction, monitors, who does what. Theatre calls it a time-out; the emergency department calls it a checklist. Same thing.

plain.zh: 呼出氣體的二氧化碳曲線。有波形才算管子在氣管裡；沒有波形就是沒有，不管你多確定看到了聲帶。
plain.en: The curve of carbon dioxide in exhaled gas. A waveform means the tube is in the airway; no waveform means it is not, however sure you are that you saw the cords.

plain.zh: 插管時助手用雙手固定頭頸，不讓脖子動，因為頸圈必須暫時打開。喉鏡視野會變差，所以更要用影像喉鏡。
plain.en: An assistant holds the head and neck still with both hands during intubation because the collar must be opened. The laryngoscopic view gets worse, which is one more reason for a videolaryngoscope.

plain.zh: 喉結下方那一小片軟的地方。計畫 D 從這裡切進氣道。困難氣道誘導之前，先用手或超音波找到它、畫上記號。
plain.en: The small soft patch just below the Adam's apple. Plan D enters the airway here. Before inducing a difficult airway, find it by hand or ultrasound and mark it.

plain.zh: 計畫 A 還沒開始，計畫 D 已經擺好：環甲膜畫好、刀和管在手邊、誰來切說好了。希望用不到，但準備得像會用到。
plain.en: Plan D is laid out before plan A begins: membrane marked, scalpel and tube at hand, the person who cuts agreed. You hope not to use it and prepare as though you will.

plain.zh: 尖端有鏡頭的喉鏡，螢幕上看聲帶。頸椎固定、嘴巴張不開的病人靠它。嘴裡全是血的時候，鏡頭也會糊掉。
plain.en: A laryngoscope with a camera at the tip and the cords on a screen. Essential when the neck is held still or the mouth barely opens. When the mouth is full of blood, the lens fogs too.

plain.zh: 誘導藥會擴張血管、壓抑心臟；正壓通氣又減少回心血。本來就在出血或休克的病人，誘導後血壓會掉得很深。所以復甦在前。
plain.en: Induction drugs dilate vessels and depress the heart; positive-pressure ventilation then cuts venous return. In a patient already bleeding or shocked, the pressure falls hard after induction. Hence resuscitate first.

plain.zh: 一次叫來成套的紅血球、血漿、血小板，按比例一起給，而不是一袋一袋想。啟動是一通電話，不是一個數字。
plain.en: Red cells, plasma and platelets called up as a set and given together in proportion, not bag by bag as you go. Activating it is a phone call, not a number.

text.zh: 影像喉鏡、探條、聲門上呼吸道、頸部切開組、兩套抽吸。每一層一個計畫。到急診之前先數一遍。
text.en: Videolaryngoscope, bougie, supraglottic airway, front-of-neck kit, two suction sets. One drawer per plan. Counted before you leave for the emergency department.

text.zh: 一條會塞住。吐血的病人要兩條，而且是大口徑的。開著，不是放著。
text.en: One will block. A patient vomiting blood needs two, wide bore. Running, not lying there.

text.zh: 找環甲膜：喉結往下，氣管軟骨環之間第一個亮線。畫一條線，寫上「D」。
text.en: Finding the cricothyroid membrane: down from the Adam's apple to the first bright line between the cartilages. Draw a line, write 'D'.

text.zh: 鏡頭在尖端。進去之前先抽吸，不然你會看到一片紅。
text.en: Camera at the tip. Suction before it goes in, or all you will see is red.

text.zh: 你用超音波找到環甲膜後畫的。插管成功後它還在，提醒每個人今晚差了多少。
text.en: Drawn after you found the cricothyroid membrane with ultrasound. Still there after the tube went in, reminding everyone how close it was.

text.zh: 快速誘導插管、嘴裡有血、計畫 A 第一次成功、誘導後低血壓已處理。內視鏡室和加護病房各一份。
text.en: Rapid sequence induction, blood in the mouth, plan A first pass, post-induction hypotension managed. One copy for endoscopy, one for intensive care.

text.zh: 最難的氣道不一定是看不到聲門的氣道，而是生理上不穩的氣道：在出血、休克、缺氧的病人身上，誘導藥和正壓通氣會把血壓推下去。先有血、先有升壓藥、先有氧氣，再給藥。能等三分鐘，就等三分鐘。
text.en: The hardest airway is not always the one with no view; it is the physiologically unstable one. In a bleeding, shocked or hypoxic patient, induction drugs and positive pressure push the blood pressure off a cliff. Blood, pressors and oxygen first, then the drugs. If you can wait three minutes, wait three minutes.

name.zh: 急診的每個胃都是飽的
name.en: Every stomach in the emergency department is full

text.zh: 禁食時間在急診沒有意義：疼痛、鴉片類、出血、酒精、懷孕、創傷都讓胃停住。所以一律快速誘導插管、頭高、雙抽吸。問「幾點吃的」只是為了紀錄，不是為了決定。
text.en: Fasting times mean little here: pain, opioids, bleeding, alcohol, pregnancy and trauma all stop the stomach. So it is always a rapid sequence, head-up, two suctions. You ask 'when did you eat' for the record, not for the decision.

text.zh: 預期困難的氣道，先畫脖子再開始。環甲膜找好、刀和管擺好、誰切說好。這不是悲觀，是讓計畫 A 的人可以專心，因為他知道計畫 D 已經有人顧。
text.en: For an anticipated difficult airway, mark the neck before you start. Membrane found, scalpel and tube laid out, the person who cuts agreed. Not pessimism: it lets the plan A person concentrate, knowing plan D is already covered.

lines.zh: 交班板：「急診：肝硬化吐血一位，意識變差，內視鏡室在等。救護車通報：機車顏面外傷，二十分鐘。」
lines.en: Board: 'ED: one cirrhotic vomiting blood, becoming confused, endoscopy waiting. Ambulance call: motorbike, facial injuries, twenty minutes.'

lines.zh: 麻醉科？太好了。一床是吐血的，抽吸我開了兩條。
lines.en: Anaesthesia? Good. Bay one is the bleeder; I have two suctions running.

lines.zh: 影像喉鏡電量、探條、聲門上呼吸道兩個尺寸、頸部切開組、鼻導管。一層一層拉開。
lines.en: Videolaryngoscope battery, bougie, two sizes of supraglottic airway, front-of-neck kit, nasal cannula. Drawer by drawer.

q.zh: 點選氣道推車，確認計畫 A 到 D 每一層都在。
q.en: Tap the airway trolley and confirm every drawer, plan A to D, is stocked.

post.zh: 四層都在。頸部切開組的封條沒拆過。希望今晚也一樣。
post.en: All four drawers present. The front-of-neck kit seal is intact. Let us keep it that way tonight.

lines.zh: （喝一口冷茶）問你：急診插管和手術室插管，差在哪裡？
lines.en: (a sip of cold tea) Tell me: how is an emergency-department intubation different from one in theatre?

lines.zh: 每一個都是飽胃，每一個都可能不穩，而且沒有人幫我排好刀表。
lines.en: Every patient is a full stomach, every one may be unstable, and nobody has written me a list.

lines.zh: 對。所以今晚的順序只有一個：復甦在前，插管在後。
lines.en: Right. So tonight there is only one order of things: resuscitate first, intubate second.

sub.zh: 肝硬化吐血，意識變差，要保護氣道
sub.en: Cirrhotic vomiting blood, obtunded, needs airway protection

lines.zh: 麻醉科嗎？六十七歲男性，肝硬化，疑似食道靜脈瘤出血，吐血兩盆，血壓偏低，叫不太醒。內視鏡要做，但他保護不了氣道。
lines.en: Anaesthesia? Sixty-seven-year-old man, cirrhosis, probable oesophageal varices bleeding, two basins of blood, pressure low, now barely rousable and trying to sit up. Endoscopy is needed, but he cannot protect his airway.

lines.zh: 收到。大量輸血啟動了嗎？升壓藥備好、頭高、兩條抽吸。我五分鐘到，到了先講計畫。
lines.en: Understood. Is massive transfusion activated? Pressors ready, head-up, two suctions. Five minutes; I brief the plan when I arrive.

post.zh: （走在你旁邊）他嘴裡全是血，影像喉鏡會糊。計畫 A 之前先想：抽吸在哪、計畫 D 在哪。
post.en: (walking beside you) His mouth is full of blood; the videolaryngoscope will fog. Before plan A, think: where is the suction, where is plan D.

note.zh: 老何的氣道建立，血壓撐住
note.en: Mr Ho's airway secured, pressure held

lines.zh: 醫師，他上個月真的戒了！他晚餐只喝了一點粥，六點。
lines.en: Doctor, he really did stop drinking last month! He only had a little congee for dinner, at six.

lines.zh: 謝謝你告訴我。不過吐血的胃，不管幾點吃的，我們都當飽胃處理。
lines.en: Thank you for telling me. But a stomach full of blood is a full stomach whatever time he ate.

lines.zh: （含糊）我要坐起來……
lines.en: (slurred) Let me sit up...

post.zh: 血壓又掉了一點。第一袋血剛掛上。
post.en: Pressure has dipped again. First unit of blood just up.

lines.zh: 內視鏡室在催，黃醫師在旁邊，兒子在哭。你現在要先做什麼？
lines.en: Endoscopy is chasing, Dr Huang is at your elbow, the son is crying. What do you do first?

q.zh: 老何的誘導，順序怎麼排？
q.en: Mr Ho's induction: what comes first?

options.zh: 先復甦：血、升壓藥、頭高、雙抽吸，再誘導
options.en: Resuscitate: blood, pressors, head-up, two suctions, then induce

why.zh: 出血中的病人誘導後血壓會掉得很深。先有血和升壓藥，誘導劑量由主治依狀況調整。能等三分鐘，就等三分鐘。
why.en: A bleeding patient's pressure falls hard after induction. Blood and pressors first; the consultant adjusts the induction to the state he is in. If you can wait three minutes, wait three minutes.

options.zh: 馬上插管，他一直在吐，不能等
options.en: Intubate now, he keeps vomiting, no time

why.zh: 他確實需要管子，但給藥的那一秒如果血壓沒有後盾，你會同時面對沒氣道和沒血壓。準備升壓藥不需要三分鐘。
why.en: He does need the tube, but if there is nothing behind the pressure when the drug goes in, you face no airway and no blood pressure at once. Pressors take less than three minutes to prepare.

options.zh: 等內視鏡室叫了再過去插
options.en: Wait until endoscopy calls, then intubate there

why.zh: 搬運中失去氣道是最糟的地方。能在急救區安全建立的氣道，不要帶到走廊上。
why.en: Losing the airway in transit is the worst place to lose it. An airway you can secure safely in resus does not belong in a corridor.

lines.zh: 準備好了。檢核表誰念？
lines.en: Ready. Who reads the checklist?

lines.zh: 我念。老何，靜脈瘤出血，飽胃，快速誘導插管。A 影像喉鏡加探條，B 聲門上呼吸道，C 面罩兩人法，D 環甲膜，簡主治切。
lines.en: Me. Mr Ho, probable variceal bleed, full stomach, rapid sequence induction. Plan A videolaryngoscope and bougie, B supraglottic airway, C two-person mask, D cricothyroid membrane, Dr Chien cuts.

post.zh: （站在你旁邊）我負責壓環狀軟骨？
post.en: (at your elbow) Do I press on the cricoid?
You are in charge of not blocking the suction.

lines.zh: 頭高三十度，鼻導管開著，面罩密合。他會吐，抽吸頭放他嘴角。預充氧做不到完美，就做到最好。
lines.en: Thirty degrees head-up, nasal oxygen running, a good mask seal. He will vomit; suction tip at the corner of his mouth. Pre-oxygenation will not be perfect, so make it as good as it gets.

post.zh: 第二袋血上了。升壓藥接好了。
post.en: Second unit up. Pressor line connected.

lines.zh: 藥給了。先抽吸，再進鏡。看到一片紅就退出來抽，不要在裡面找。
lines.en: Drugs in. Suction first, then the blade. If all you see is red, come out and suction; do not hunt in there.

post.zh: 抽吸、進鏡、探條過聲門、管子跟上。二氧化碳波形……有了。
post.en: Suction, blade, bougie through the cords, tube follows. Capnography... there it is.
Only the waveform counts. Secure it.

lines.zh: 管子固定好，呼吸器接上。一分鐘後，監視器的數字開始往下走。
lines.en: Tube secured, ventilator connected. A minute later the numbers on the monitor start to slide.

options.zh: 升壓藥與輸血依醫囑、減少正壓、找出血、叫人
options.en: Pressors and blood per protocol, ease the pressure, find the bleeding, call for help

why.zh: 誘導後低血壓在出血的病人幾乎一定發生。藥物已經備好就能立刻用；正壓通氣減少回心血，要調整；出血本身還在，內視鏡要快。
why.en: Post-induction hypotension is near certain in a bleeding patient. Drugs already drawn up can be given at once; positive pressure cuts venous return and needs easing; the bleeding is ongoing, so endoscopy must move.

options.en: Deepen the anaesthetic so he does not move

why.zh: 他沒有在動，他在休克。更多麻醉藥只會把血壓壓得更低。
why.en: He is not moving; he is in shock. More anaesthetic only pushes the pressure lower.

options.zh: 先照胸部 X 光確認管子位置
options.en: Chest X-ray first to confirm tube position

why.zh: 二氧化碳波形已經告訴你管子在氣管裡。現在的問題是血壓，不是管子。
why.en: Capnography has already told you the tube is in the airway. The problem now is the pressure, not the tube.

post.zh: 因為你先備了血和升壓藥，這一段只有兩分鐘。記住這兩分鐘的感覺。
post.en: Because you had blood and pressors ready, that lasted two minutes. Remember how those two minutes felt.

lines.zh: 管子固定好，呼吸器接上。血壓掉得又快又深，升壓藥還在抽，第二袋血還沒到。小潔把急救車的門打開。
lines.en: Tube secured, ventilator on. The pressure falls fast and deep; the pressor is still being drawn up, the second unit has not arrived. Chieh opens the crash-cart doors.

options.zh: 升壓藥與輸血依醫囑、減少正壓、找出血、叫人
options.en: Pressors and blood per protocol, ease the pressure, find the bleeding, call for help

why.zh: 你現在做的每一件事都是對的，只是晚了三分鐘。誘導後低血壓在出血的病人幾乎一定發生，準備要在藥給之前。
why.en: Everything you are doing now is right, just three minutes late. Post-induction hypotension is near certain in a bleeding patient; the preparation belongs before the drug.

options.en: Deepen the anaesthetic so he does not move

why.zh: 他沒有在動，他在休克。更多麻醉藥只會把血壓壓得更低。
why.en: He is not moving; he is in shock. More anaesthetic only pushes the pressure lower.

options.zh: 先照胸部 X 光確認管子位置
options.en: Chest X-ray first to confirm tube position

why.zh: 二氧化碳波形已經告訴你管子在氣管裡。現在的問題是血壓，不是管子。
why.en: Capnography has already told you the tube is in the airway. The problem now is the pressure, not the tube.

post.zh: （很慢地）撐回來了。這五分鐘本來可以是兩分鐘。復甦在前，插管在後。今晚記住就好。
post.en: (slowly) Back up. Those five minutes could have been two. Resuscitate first, intubate second. Just remember it tonight.

note.zh: 老何交給內視鏡室與加護病房
note.en: Mr Ho handed to endoscopy and intensive care

guide.zh: 插管後的胸部 X 光

lines.zh: 片子出來了。插管後的胸部 X 光，你要看什麼？
lines.en: Film is up. What are you looking for on a post-intubation chest X-ray?

question.zh: 插管後的胸部 X 光，要確認哪幾件事？
question.en: After intubation, what must the chest film confirm?

answer.zh: 氣管內管尖端在隆突上方幾公分、沒有滑進右主支氣管；鼻胃管走在食道裡、尖端在胃；有沒有誤吸的新陰影，常在重力低處；有沒有氣胸或大量胸水。管子的位置靠二氧化碳波形確認「在氣管」，靠影像確認「深度剛好」。
answer.en: Tube tip a few centimetres above the carina, not down the right main bronchus; the nasogastric tube running in the oesophagus with its tip in the stomach; any new shadow of aspiration, usually in the dependent zones; any pneumothorax or large effusion. Capnography proves the tube is in the airway; the film proves the depth is right.

sub.zh: 準備好了，可以送過來；加護病房已留床
sub.en: Ready, send him over; intensive care has a bed

lines.zh: 內視鏡室的訊息：「準備好了，可以送過來。」加護病房也留了床。
lines.en: Message from endoscopy: 'Ready, send him over.' Intensive care has a bed too.

lines.zh: 送之前，紀錄寫好、通知到位。寫給下一個插他管的人看。
lines.en: Before he goes: record written, everyone informed. Write it for the next person who has to intubate him.

post.en: Doctor... will he be all right?

post.zh: 現在氣道安全了，血壓撐住了，接下來內視鏡去止血。我們一步一步來。
post.en: His airway is safe now and his pressure is holding; next, endoscopy stops the bleeding. One step at a time.

lines.zh: 快速誘導插管用掉的每一支藥補回，抽吸頭換新，影像喉鏡充電。下一個二十分鐘後到。
lines.en: Replace every ampoule the rapid sequence used, new suction tips, videolaryngoscope on charge. The next one is twenty minutes out.

sub.zh: 機車對汽車，顏面外傷，躁動，頸圈
sub.en: Motorbike versus car, facial injuries, agitated, in a collar

lines.zh: 二十八歲男性，機車對汽車，安全帽飛了。下巴和鼻子變形，嘴裡有血，自己呼吸，血氧還可以，躁動，有酒味，頸圈固定。五分鐘。
lines.en: Twenty-eight-year-old male, motorbike versus car, helmet came off. Jaw and nose deformed, blood in the mouth, breathing on his own, saturation acceptable, agitated, smells of alcohol, collar on. Five minutes.

lines.zh: 顏面外傷、嘴裡有血、頸圈、躁動。這是預期困難氣道。他需要的是一根管子，還是一個計畫？
lines.en: Facial trauma, blood in the mouth, collar, agitation. That is an anticipated difficult airway. Does he need a tube, or does he need a plan?

lines.zh: 先一個計畫。電腦斷層需要他不動，所以最後大概還是要管子。但先畫脖子。
lines.en: A plan first. The CT needs him still, so it probably ends in a tube. But we mark the neck first.

lines.zh: 阿勇到了。頸圈、面罩、血、酒味，還有一隻一直想拔面罩的手。
lines.en: A-Yung arrives: collar, mask, blood, the smell of alcohol, and a hand that keeps reaching for the mask.

lines.zh: 從到達到給藥，順序排給我看。
lines.en: From arrival to drugs, lay the order out for me.

q.zh: 預期困難氣道的雙重準備
q.en: Double set-up for an anticipated difficult airway

steps.zh: 氣道評估，徒手頸椎固定

steps.en: Find and mark the cricothyroid membrane

steps.zh: 團隊簡報：計畫 A 到 D 與角色
steps.en: Team brief: plans A to D and roles

lines.zh: 脖子腫，用手摸不準。超音波：喉結往下，軟骨環之間第一條亮線。畫一條線，寫 D。
lines.en: The neck is swollen and hard to palpate. Ultrasound: down from the Adam's apple, first bright line between the cartilages. Draw a line, write D.

lines.zh: （含糊）你們要在我脖子上幹嘛……
lines.en: (slurred) What are you doing to my neck...

lines.zh: 阿勇，畫一條我們希望用不到的線。
lines.en: A-Yung, drawing a line we hope not to use.

post.zh: 計畫 D 的門檻你講得對：不是「試很多次之後」，是「沒有氧氣的時候」。
post.en: You have the plan D threshold right: not 'after many attempts', but 'when there is no oxygen'.

note.zh: 阿勇的氣道建立，送電腦斷層
note.en: A-Yung's airway secured, off to CT

lines.zh: 頸圈打開，我做徒手頸椎固定。抽吸兩條都開了。
lines.en: Collar open, I have manual in-line stabilisation. Both suctions running.

lines.zh: 藥給了。影像喉鏡進去。
lines.en: Drugs in. Videolaryngoscope going in.

lines.zh: 螢幕上一片紅，退出來抽吸，再進去。會厭看到了，聲門只看到一半。血氧開始往下。
lines.en: The screen is red; out, suction, back in. Epiglottis seen, half the glottis. The saturation starts to fall.

options.zh: 宣告、面罩或聲門上呼吸道恢復氧合、換人換法
options.en: Declare, oxygenate with mask or supraglottic airway, change operator and approach

why.zh: 困難氣道最危險的是一直試。恢復氧合，然後換人、換角度、用探條。脖子上的線還在，但門檻是「沒有氧氣」，不是「我看不到」。
why.en: The danger in a difficult airway is trying again and again. Restore oxygen, then change operator, angle and use the bougie. The line on the neck is still there, but its threshold is 'no oxygen', not 'I cannot see'.

options.zh: 再試一次，這次用力上提
options.en: One more go, lift harder this time

why.zh: 頸椎固定下用力上提只會移動脖子，不會改善視野。固著是最常見的錯。
why.en: Lifting harder under in-line stabilisation moves the neck, not the view. Fixation is the commonest error.

why.zh: 還能用面罩或聲門上呼吸道給氧的時候，還沒到計畫 D。線畫好了，不代表現在就要用。
why.en: While mask or supraglottic airway can still deliver oxygen, you are not yet at plan D. Marking the line does not mean using it now.

post.zh: 聲門上呼吸道放進去，血氧爬回來。簡主治接手，抽吸、探條、影像喉鏡換角度，管子進去。二氧化碳波形。
post.en: Supraglottic airway in, saturation climbing back. Dr Chien takes over: suction, bougie, a new angle on the videolaryngoscope, tube in. Capnography.

post.zh: （慢慢地）線還在他脖子上。今晚它只是一條線。
post.en: (slowly) The line is still on his neck. Tonight it stayed a line.

lines.zh: 搬運前：管子深度、固定、氧氣筒、監視器、藥、誰推。搬運中掉的氣道，比插不到的更多。
lines.en: Before transfer: tube depth, fixation, oxygen cylinder, monitor, drugs, who pushes. More airways are lost in transit than at laryngoscopy.

lines.zh: 都確認了。頸圈重新戴好。
lines.en: All checked. Collar back on.

lines.zh: （還站在旁邊）那……可以掃了嗎？
lines.en: (still at your elbow) So... can we scan now?

lines.zh: 可以了，黃醫師。
lines.en: Now you can, Dr Huang.

lines.zh: 交班板：「老何，快速誘導插管，內視鏡止血後入加護病房。阿勇，困難氣道，計畫 A 二次成功，環甲膜已標記，電腦斷層中。」
lines.en: Board: 'Mr Ho, rapid sequence induction, endoscopy haemostasis, now in intensive care. A-Yung, difficult airway, plan A on the second pass, membrane marked, in CT.'

lines.zh: （訊息）聽說你今晚畫了一條線，沒有用到。這就是雙重準備。明天白板見。
lines.en: (message) I hear you drew a line tonight and did not need it. That is the double set-up. See you at the board tomorrow.

lines.zh: 今晚兩條氣道，最重要的決定是哪一個？
lines.en: Two airways tonight. Which decision mattered most?

lines.zh: 老何那邊，是先復甦。阿勇那邊，是先畫脖子。都在給藥之前。
lines.en: For Mr Ho, resuscitating first. For A-Yung, marking the neck first. Both before the drugs.

lines.zh: 對。氣道不是靠手快，是靠給藥前那三分鐘。（舉起保溫杯）敬冷茶。去睡一下，呼叫器我拿著。
lines.en: Yes. Airways are not won by fast hands but by the three minutes before the drug. (raising the flask) To cold tea. Get some sleep; I will hold the pager.

sub.zh: 兩條氣道、兩盆血、一條沒用到的線
sub.en: Two airways, two basins of blood, one line never used
